home.privacy.badge: No trackers · No analytics · No accounts
home.privacy.body: No third-party analytics. No tracking pixels. No fingerprinting. No external JS or fonts. No ads. No accounts, no email, no data sold or shared.
home.privacy.title: What we don't do
home.privacy.what_we_log.item1: Your IP for rate limiting — kept for 8 hours in Redis, then dropped.
home.privacy.what_we_log.item2: The IP that created a mock — to enforce the 50-mocks-per-IP limit. Never shown in the UI.
home.privacy.what_we_log.item3: Requests to your mocks — that's the inspector feature. You can clear them any time, and they disappear when the mock expires.
home.privacy.what_we_log.item4: Your language preference, in a cookie. That's it for cookies.
home.privacy.what_we_log.title: What we do log (and why)
home.security.body: Mocks are public — anyone with the URL can read the response body. Never put real API keys, access tokens, passwords, or production data into a mock.
home.security.title: Don't paste real secrets

seo.description: Quickmock — free HTTP mock API in 30 seconds. Pick method, status, body — get a public URL. Live request inspector. No signup, no tracking, open source.
seo.faq.a1: Quickmock is a free online tool that creates a public HTTP mock endpoint in 30 seconds. You paste a response body, pick a method and status code, and get a URL you can call from any client — curl, Postman, your frontend, a CI test, anywhere.
seo.faq.a2: No. There is no account, no email, no credit card. Mocks are limited per IP and expire after the TTL you pick (up to 30 days). The service is free and open source.
seo.faq.a3: Frontend prototyping while the backend is not ready, webhook testing, integration and contract tests, reproducing edge cases like 500 errors or slow responses, API demos, and teaching examples.
seo.faq.a4: Yes. Every mock has a live inspector that shows incoming requests in real time — method, path, headers, query, and body. You can clear the log any time.
seo.faq.q2: Do I need to sign up or pay?
seo.faq.q3: What can I use Quickmock for?
seo.faq.a5: Yes. Drop tokens like {{faker.uuid}}, {{faker.name}}, {{faker.email}}, or {{now.iso8601}} into the response body — the mock stores the template as-is and substitutes fresh values on every hit. Full list of 22 tokens (people, IDs, network, text, time) is in the form under "Dynamic tokens".
seo.faq.q4: Can I see who calls my mock?
seo.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
seo.feature_list: Free HTTP mock endpoints; custom status codes and headers; configurable response delay; live request inspector; no signup; open source; no tracking
